verdict.rationale: Plaid publishes an official Node SDK under its own GitHub organization (plaid/plaid-node). The repo shows typed client calls such as plaidClient.transactionsSync and documents async/await error handling. The docs also offer a cloneable Quickstart app and a fully featured Sandbox to build and test against. missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs in other languages, first-party docs listing and describing the SDK lineup, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
